objective: Test whether the causally qualified address-keyed recurrent RWKV-MS plus sparse DeepEmbed outer-FFN hybrid improves native scene-boundary generation over its exact projected-only carrier and over recurrent-state interventions on open publisher-TRAIN-derived development data.

architecture.attention_role: A learned three-expert router combines projected-addressed recurrent RWKV read, global recurrent RWKV read, and a projected-only abstention arm at all 42 layers.
architecture.write_role: Projected address conditions recurrent RWKV k/v/a/b writes.
architecture.outer_ffn_role: Sparse DeepEmbed ChannelMix uses the recurrent correction to multiplicatively modulate frozen Gemma MLP channels at layers 10, 21, 31, and 41.
architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: With zero recurrent state, both recurrent attention corrections are exactly zero and the DeepEmbed channel scale is exactly one, leaving the fixed projected carrier.
architecture.projected_only_bypass: Set memory_readout_mode to projected_kv_slots and temporarily select a non-DeepEmbed hybrid mode so the registered FFN hooks are inactive; use the same zero recurrent state and unchanged projected carrier. No tensor or learned parameter is changed.

generation.hardware: four distinct A100 GPUs, one deterministic shard per GPU
generation.projected_carrier_policy: The correct row's projected carrier is byte-identical in every condition.
generation.donor_policy: Deterministic prompt-length-matched donor with different gold boundaries.
generation.decoding: The repository's frozen deterministic native generation configuration.
generation.batch_shape_control: Generate zero, correct, donor, and layer-permuted recurrent conditions together at batch size four. Generate the explicit projected-only bypass at the same batch size four using four copies of the identical zero-recurrent state, and compare the same batch position.
generation.resume_policy: Hash-bound append-only JSONL per shard and condition.

stopping_rule.pass: Establish open-development native recurrent plus outer-FFN causal gain for this hybrid, update the README, archive the signed result, commit, and push.
stopping_rule.failure: Do not claim native gain; archive the signed failure and use the condition metrics to select a genuinely different hybrid or training objective before further generation testing.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, or the unused 73-row strength holdout.

claim_policy.pass: May claim open-development native gain over the matched projected-only carrier with causal attribution to the combined recurrent RWKV plus sparse outer-FFN path under the locked interventions.
claim_policy.failure: May claim only the held-out teacher-forced causal preference, not native generation gain.
claim_policy.component_attribution: This benchmark isolates the combined recurrent attention and recurrent-conditioned outer-FFN path. It does not separately attribute any gain between those two components.
claim_policy.protected_replication: Forbidden without a new preregistered protocol.
